mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_file (revision_id, module, path, source_root, language, file_type, package_name, encoding , checksum, size_bytes, line_count, parse_status, parse_error) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{module}, #{path}, #{sourceRoot}, #{language}, #{fileType}, #{packageName}, #{encoding} , #{checksum}, #{sizeBytes}, #{lineCount, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{parseStatus}, #{parseError}) ON CONFLICT (revision_id, path) DO UPDATE SET module = EXCLUDED.module , source_root = EXCLUDED.source_root , language = EXCLUDED.language , file_type = EXCLUDED.file_type , package_name = EXCLUDED.package_name , encoding = EXCLUDED.encoding , checksum = EXCLUDED.checksum , size_bytes = EXCLUDED.size_bytes , line_count = EXCLUDED.line_count , parse_status = EXCLUDED.parse_status , parse_error = EXCLUDED.parse_error
mapper.select: SELECT file_id AS "fileId" , module AS "module" , path AS "path" , source_root AS "sourceRoot" , language AS "language" , file_type AS "fileType" , package_name AS "packageName" , encoding AS "encoding" , language_level AS "languageLevel" , checksum AS "checksum" , size_bytes AS "sizeBytes" , line_count AS "lineCount" , parse_status AS "parseStatus" , parse_error AS "parseError" FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND language = #{language} AND file_type = #{fileType} AND encoding = #{encoding} AND path LIKE '%' || #{pathLike} || '%' AND = #{roleGroup} AND = #{roleKind} ORDER BY path LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT language AS "language" , file_type AS "fileType" , COUNT(*) AS "fileCount" , COALESCE(SUM(line_count), 0) AS "lineCount" , COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0) AS "sizeBytes" FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY language, file_type ORDER BY language, file_type
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN analysis_file.language = 'JAVA' THEN 'JAVA' WHEN analysis_file.file_type IN ('JSP', 'WEBSQUARE', 'NEXACRO', 'NEXACRO_APP', 'VUE', 'REACT', 'SCRIPT') THEN 'SCREEN' WHEN analysis_file.file_type IN ('MYBATIS_MAPPER', 'IBATIS_MAPPER', 'QUERY_XML', 'DDL', 'SQL_SCRIPT') THEN 'SQL' WHEN analysis_file.file_type IN ('MYBATIS_CONFIG', 'SPRING_XML', 'STRUTS_CONFIG', 'WEB_XML', 'CONFIG', 'BUILD', 'LOG_CONFIG') THEN 'CONFIG' ELSE 'OTHER' END

CASE WHEN analysis_file.language = 'JAVA' THEN COALESCE(( SELECT s.layer FROM analysis_symbol s WHERE s.revision_id = analysis_file.revision_id AND s.file_id = analysis_file.file_id AND s.outer_symbol_id IS NULL AND s.kind <> 'ANONYMOUS' ORDER BY s.line_start NULLS LAST, s.symbol_id LIMIT 1), '(없음)') ELSE COALESCE(analysis_file.file_type, analysis_file.language) END
mapper.select: SELECT AS "group" , AS "kind" , language AS "language" , COUNT(*) AS "fileCount" , COALESCE(SUM(line_count), 0) AS "lineCount" FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1, 4 DESC, 2
SELECT COALESCE(encoding, '(없음)') AS "encoding" , COUNT(*) AS "fileCount" FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY encoding ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT COALESCE(module, '') AS "module" , COALESCE(source_root, '(못 찾음)') AS "sourceRoot" , COUNT(*) AS "fileCount" FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND language = 'JAVA' GROUP BY module, source_root ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
